rules.threshold_scope: same supplementary source and same ROI, offline descriptive calibration

parameters.weighted_median_method: smallest ordered value whose cumulative duration reaches half the total
parameters.calibration_scope: same-source offline development; not held-out evaluation or road capacity
parameters.motion_history_reset: missing observation, different assigned zone, invalid frame or nonconsecutive frame index
parameters.motion_unit: source-image pixels per second; not km/h

rules.calibration_eligibility: only complete 10 s windows with valid coverage and no >0.5 s held frame overlap
rules.count_calibration: all eligible count means including zeros; P33/P67 linear interpolation (n-1)*q; equal thresholds cannot separate nonzero count levels
rules.motion_calibration: P25 from eligible windows with available motion; at least 30 such windows per region
rules.frozen_rule_semantics: unchanged count/joint conditions and 30 s persistence; lack of motion resets joint streak, not valid high-count-only streak
rules.conservative_display_semantics: evidence_state unknown whenever window incomplete/held/missing, count thresholds indistinguishable, motion unavailable, or P25 unavailable; preserves separate pure-count hint
rules.zero_observations: relative_count_level=empty is only zero observed count; evidence_state unknown, never free flow
rules.null_semantics: unavailable absolute motion remains null; available absolute motion remains numeric even if P25 is null; motion_low_relative is null if absolute motion or P25 unavailable
rules.confirmation_time: window end in original source PTS; thresholds use the whole source, so this is retrospective replay timing, not prospective real-time availability
rules.high_count_persistent_count_only: boolean condition high-count duration >=30 s; includes joint hints as a subset; do not add counts
rules.frozen_state_hint: state_hint is exact frozen classifier output and must not override evidence_state unknown in future UI

lighting_caution: Short daylight Train source, not independent Validation.
notes: Full original recording with saved per-frame tracked boxes and ROI outlines; not live inference.
10-second summaries are offline and appear only after window end.
Main state uses conservative evidence_state. A count-only sustained hint is separate and cannot replace unknown.
Each recording calibrates its own P33/P67 count and P25 motion thresholds. Cross-recording grades are not comparable.
Image motion is pixels per second, not road speed. No congestion accuracy has been validated.
